'''Elsinore-Cordova Engineering''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-manufacturing corporation that did business in the decades before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The company produced the [[Tri-Mark VII Interceptor]], one of which, the [[Longshot (Tri-Mark VII Interceptor)|''Longshot'']], was owned by [[Meeko Ghintee]]. The company also manufactured the [[TurboDyne 99-U/Legends|''TurboDyne'' 99-U engine]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]].
